products.originalName: Scentos® Fruit-Scented Chisel-Tip Markers - Brights - 24 Count Set
products.originalBodyHtml:
Our scented chisel-tip super-washable markers are back, with a "glow-up" of better scents, cuter characters, and longer-lasting color! This sweet-scented pack of twenty-four (24) scented chisel-tip markers are great for kids and adults, students and teachers, classrooms and everyday play! In 12 fruit-scented bright colors, two sets of each color - with scents like watermelon, strawberry, orange, banana, green apple, blueberry, sugared macaron, chocolate and more - feature friendly characters in each adorable design, great for keeping kids engaged in coloring for longer periods. With the ability to write in a thick or thin line, these markers come in a fun pack, perfect for gifts or everyday, great for posters, projects and more - kids and adults worldwide have fallen in love for fifteen years.

  • 24 Scentos® scented chisel-tip markers (2 sets of 12 colors)
  • Angled edge makes thick or thin lines
  • Fruity, premium scents and adorably-designed characters on each marker
  • Easy to use for ages 3+
  • Safe and non-toxic; super washable
  • Designed in the USA
